FieldSet.description: ALF-RS-12 (LFRDN-342). Fields AF_DocumentConditionEvaluator may reference when evaluating AF_DocumentCondition__mdt rows scoped to AF_Handover__c via AF_DynamicObject__mdt. The single Handover condition is unconditional ("true"), but AF_Status__c is included so a future branch (e.g. by brand or business unit) can be added without a field-set/deploy change.
FieldSet.label: AF Document Condition Fields
